name: Manastorm Shadowfang Keep: Duo Archmage Arugal does not full-heal when his Curse charms the only engaged attacker (#10356)
contract: when ManastormMgr::GetRunFor(player)->GetMode() == ManastormMode::Solo; every other mode (Duo, Trio, Group)
returns early and leaves Arugal's evade path unsuppressed. #8345's own diagnosis of the root cause is not
about party size: 'the boss's only threat reference reads as friendly and SelectVictim() falls through to
EnterEvadeMode()' whenever Arugal's Curse charms the single player he is actually fighting. That happens in
any mode when only one party member is engaged with Arugal and the others are not (out of range, not yet
arrived, or otherwise uninvolved) -- the boss's threat list has exactly one entry at the moment the charm
lands, same as the solo case.
This scenario runs a two-player (Duo) Manastorm segment test (ManastormModeForMemberCount(2) == Duo). n1
walks up and engages Arugal alone; n2 stays back in the entry room, out of range and never engaging, so
Arugal's threat list holds only n1 when the curse is forced. The fix widens SetArugalEvadeSuppressed() to
every mode; without it, Arugal evades (his Chaotic Link encounter aura 93459 is stripped by
Unit::RemoveEvadeAuras() and he becomes unattackable) the instant the forced charm lands, exactly as in the

steps.label: n2 joins n1's group so the run starts in Duo mode
CONTROL: n1 (the leader) entered a private Manastorm instance
CONTROL: n2 was brought along into the same private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible to this lane
n1 walks up to Arugal alone; n2 stays back out of range
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears n1's safety aura
CONTROL: n2 never approached Arugal, so it is not within attack range of him
CONTROL: n1 is not charmed before Arugal's Curse is cast
CONTROL: Arugal's Chaotic Link encounter aura is present before the charm
Arugal is engaged and attackable ahead of the charm (setup is otherwise correct)
Select Arugal so '.cast back' can resolve him as the caster
Let a little real combat happen before forcing the cast
n1 is charmed by Arugal's Curse
Arugal did not evade in Duo mode either: his Chaotic Link encounter aura survives the charm
Arugal did not evade in Duo mode either: he is still attackable, not reset out of combat
